_about: v3.1 photo picks for routes that had only the placeholder (James review B7). Each file shows the route itself or a named place on it; the caption names the place photographed. scripts/fetch-route-photos.mjs checks the licence with the Commons API, downloads a 1280 px copy and adds the record to data/photo-additions.json.
